outputs.explanation: Panel A is a 3D segmented tomogram rendering (schematic/structural visualization) of pre-conoidal rings and an actin filament, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a 3D segmented rendering showing cytoplasmic actin bundles and pellicular actin; it is a structural/schematic visualization, not a quantitative plot.
Panel C is a tomogram slice (micrograph) with highlighted filaments, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel D is a schematic/3D rendering of a lateral section showing nuclear, cytosolic and pellicular F-actin; it is illustrative, not a data plot.
Panel E shows a slice through an averaged tomographic volume (micrograph-type image), not a statistical plot of averages with variability.
Panel F is a tomogram slice (micrograph) showing a pellicular actin filament connected to a TPF, not a plot requiring individual data points.
